subject: Timeline deviation: MAP v3 & stakeholder action matrix
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Timeline deviation: MAP v3 & stakeholder action matrix

Jordan —

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the latest MAP (v3) and the evaluation checklist so we have a single source of truth. Two items we flagged that change the close assumptions:

- Procurement now requires SOC 2 evidence mapping to our Private offering (they requested a 5-business-day review).
- Legal indicated a minor redline in section 6.2 (data retention), which will need a short legal review cycle.

Proposed immediate next steps (short-term mitigation):
1) Redwood to push SOC 2 mapping doc to procurement by EOD Weds (action: Marissa).
2) Legal redline intake — Rachel/email legal and provide suggested phrasing by Thurs (action: Karthik).
3) Adjust MAP close date from 2027-06-10 to 2027-06-24 as a conservative re-baseline to account for reviews.

I attached an action matrix inside the MAP, but I’ll follow up with an explicit escalation note if procurement requests a longer review. Please confirm if the 6/24 target aligns with your internal timelines or if procurement needs a different window.

Attachments: MAP-v3-Orion.pdf, evaluation-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@orionhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline deviation: MAP v3 & stakeholder action matrix

Rachel —

Thanks for sending. Short answer: procurement will likely need the full SOC 2 mapping and a brief Q&A with our security team. They estimated 7 business days once they receive the artifacts, which would push us past 6/24 if we wait until Thursday. Legal flagged the redline but called it non-blocking if we accept their suggested language; I’ve looped in Alice from our legal team separately.

Can we do this instead:
- Redwood shares SOC 2 mapping tonight (we’ll fast-track review)
- Redwood provides a 30-minute security drop-in with procurement/security on Thu morning to walk the artifacts

If you can confirm availability for the drop-in, procurement will attempt to compress the window. Without that, we should plan for a 2027-07-01 close.

—Jordan
Jordan Meyers
Director, Platform Integrations — Orion Health
jordan.meyers@orionhealth.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@orionhealth.com>, procurement@orionhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline deviation: MAP v3 & stakeholder action matrix

Jordan / procurement team —

Understood and thanks for the clear ask. We’ll take the compressed path. Proposed changes to the MAP and an escalation note are below:

Updated plan (fast-track):
- Tonight (by 22:00 PT): Marissa will share the SOC 2 mapping and a one-page summary of controls that map to your procurement checklist. (attachment: MAP-v3-Orion.pdf — SOC 2 excerpt)
- Thu 06/03 10:00-10:30 PT: 30-minute security drop-in with Redwood security engineers to walk artifacts (invite to follow). (owner: Karthik)
- Thu 06/03 EOD: Procurement to provide any outstanding follow-ups; Redwood to respond within 24 hours.
- New target close: 2027-06-28 (conditional) — this assumes procurement completes review on 6/3–6/10 and legal accepts suggested redline by 6/11.

Escalation note (if procurement requests extended review):
- If procurement needs >7 business days, Redwood will offer a targeted 30-day credit and a dedicated onboarding concierge to accelerate go-live.
- We’ll escalate to our VP of Sales for approval if procurement exceeds a 10-business-day window.

I attached a short escalation-note.txt that we’ll include in the MAP if you want to share with procurement leadership. Please confirm the Thu 10:00 PT slot and we’ll send the calendar invite and the DocuSign pre-approval link for the current SOW language.

Attachments: escalation-note.txt

—Rachel
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@orionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline deviation: MAP v3 & stakeholder action matrix

Confirmed — I uploaded the SOC 2 mapping and a short control-summary into the shared MAP (link in invite). I’ll be on the Thu 10:00 security drop-in. If procurement asks for deeper evidence, we’ll open a support ticket and assign a dedicated engineer to help.

If they push the close beyond 6/28, we should proactively offer the 30-day credit as a goodwill gesture; I’ve penciled that in the action matrix under contingent offers.

—Marissa

Jordan —

Thanks — we’re aligned. Summary and asks:

- SOC 2 mapping uploaded tonight (Marissa).
- Security drop-in Thu 6/3 10:00 PT (Karthik + Redwood sec).
- Target close: 2027-06-28 (conditional on procurement + legal signoff).
- Contingency: 30-day credit and onboarding concierge if procurement requires >7 business days.
